subject.title: fix(heartbeat): add configurable idle gate for scheduled heartbeats

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a default-on 48-hour session-timestamp gate with `heartbeat.maxIdleMinutes`, or should heartbeat inactivity remain an opt-in or separately designed policy under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/14051?
rationale: The choice changes existing scheduled behavior, creates a durable public configuration contract, and selects the meaning of user activity; source review cannot safely infer that product policy.

options.title: Design the canonical policy first
options.body: Pause this PR and settle the setting name, activity signal, default behavior, documentation, and upgrade contract in the existing heartbeat-timeout discussion.

options.title: Adopt a narrow fixed safety guard
options.body: Sponsor a bounded no-new-config guard only if maintainers explicitly want a universal default safety behavior independent of the broader feature.

options.title: Accept this contract
options.body: Approve `maxIdleMinutes` and its default-on 48-hour semantics, then require documentation and fresh-install/upgrade coverage before merge.

recommendation.title: Design the canonical policy first
recommendation.body: Pause this PR and settle the setting name, activity signal, default behavior, documentation, and upgrade contract in the existing heartbeat-timeout discussion.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor routed the outstanding core heartbeat-policy decision to this reviewer.
